summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the CreatePlanSheet redesign (eventos/locales/manual picker) and the Feed overflow menu. All 7 backend tests pass (venues optional city param works for logged-in user + guest; events city param works; POST /api/plans with 3 mixed opciones -> slug + opt_ids; friend vote via /respond is reflected). All 11 frontend scenarios pass on mobile 390x844 against the public preview URL.

verifications.created_plan_url: /plan/madrid-30f1 (3 opciones listed, I'm in / voting UI visible)
verifications.backend_venues_city_param_madrid: returns Madrid venues even when user city is different

critical_code_review_comments: CreatePlanSheet submit maps non-event options to {texto_libre, venue_nombre} with the SAME value — fine for backend, but when the chosen option is a real venue (kind='venue') it still goes as texto_libre; consider adding a venue_id (if the backend supports it) so the live state 'lugar' can carry the canonical venue name/photo.
_plan_leading_option breaks ties by dict iteration order of max(); for deterministic UX, prefer tie-breaking by option definition order (plan['opciones'] index).
Feed overflow menu closes only via its invisible fullscreen overlay or route-nav; it does NOT close on Escape. Minor a11y nit — add key handler for keyboard users.
CreatePlanSheet: pressing Enter in the Discotecas/Fiestas search input currently does nothing. Consider auto-picking the top filtered result on Enter for parity with the 'A mano' tab.

seed_data_creation: Created a plan slug=madrid-30f1 titled 'TEST_iter18 picker plan' via UI, plus one via API test (also TEST_iter18). Both can be safely left — pytest attempts best-effort DELETE at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint returns {user, token} (not access_token). The event-detail entry point to CreatePlanSheet is the 'Propose to my group' / 'Montar plan' button in EventDetail — there is no data-testid on it, so page.get_by_text works. Preset event prefills opt-0 with venue name (e.g., 'Goya Social Club') not event name. plan-fab works on all logged-in feed views at 390px. Live Activity Swift redesign is iOS-native and NOT testable here per request.
